name: Maria Silva
top_risk_factors: 18 unexcused lecture absences
Failed Midterm Exam 1 (3.3/10)
Zero extracurricular engagement hours

counseling_memo.summary: Student is displaying acute disengagement driven by chronic morning absenteeism and an initial failure in core algorithms.
action_items: Issue formal attendance alert and schedule an immediate 1-on-1 counselor intake.
Assign a dedicated peer tutor for Data Structures remedial coaching.
Establish an attendance recovery agreement requiring bi-weekly advisor sign-offs.
meeting_talking_points: Inquire about personal, commute, or housing difficulties impacting morning attendance.
Discuss perceived pace of the curriculum and identify specific stumbling blocks in algorithms.

name: Lucas Santos
top_risk_factors: Accumulated 3 failed course credits from prior term
Sharp drop in continuous assessment scores (-35%)
Late tuition installment payment notification

counseling_memo.summary: Student faces compounding academic stress exacerbated by potential socio-economic or financial constraints.
action_items: Connect student with Financial Aid Office for emergency grant or payment installment plan.
Review credit overload and explore dropping one elective to stabilize core subjects.
meeting_talking_points: Check in empathetically regarding external financial or part-time job commitments.
Formulate a balanced study timetable to recover backlog subjects without burning out.

name: Beatriz Costa
top_risk_factors: Borderline introductory mathematics grade (4.8/10)
Low reported weekly independent study hours (<3 hrs/week)

counseling_memo.summary: First-year student adjusting to university academic standards with borderline quantitative results.
action_items: Enroll student in the peer-assisted study session for Quantitative Methods.
Provide time management workshop schedule.
meeting_talking_points: Explore how student is transitioning from high school to university study routines.
Recommend study groups to foster academic collaboration.

name: Rodrigo Lima
top_risk_factors: Slight decline in Lab practical attendance (1 session missed)

counseling_memo.summary: Student is in strong academic standing with consistent participation and high assessment averages.
action_items: Encourage participation in departmental undergraduate research or project leadership.
Standard mid-term progress acknowledgement.
meeting_talking_points: Congratulate on consistent academic discipline.
Discuss internship and honors program opportunities.

name: Camila Oliveira
top_risk_factors: Missed mandatory midterm project deadline
Low LMS portal activity (<2 logins per week)

counseling_memo.summary: Student is showing signs of digital disengagement and submission delinquency in core programming.
action_items: Reach out via advisor phone check-in regarding missed submission window.
Facilitate an extension review with course instructor if medical/personal cause is present.
meeting_talking_points: Discuss technical or personal barriers hindering online platform participation.
Outline milestone deadlines for the remaining semester deliverables.

name: Tiago Ferreira
top_risk_factors: Repeated failure in Structural Mechanics prerequisite
Attendance below mandatory 50% threshold
Unresponsive to academic early warning emails

counseling_memo.summary: Severe academic attrition risk marked by repeat course failures, critical attendance violations, and advisor outreach disengagement.
action_items: Schedule an urgent in-person dean's advisory conference.
Conduct an academic audit to restructure degree pathway and reduce semester course load.
Provide direct referral to student counseling and health center.
meeting_talking_points: Discuss underlying personal or emotional factors impacting continuous attendance.
Evaluate academic motivation and whether a change of major or temporary study pause is warranted.

name: Ines Martins
top_risk_factors: Clinical rotation commute conflict (working night shifts)
Minor drop in Pharmacology continuous evaluation

counseling_memo.summary: Student balances demanding vocational work shifts with clinical coursework, creating potential fatigue and schedule friction.
action_items: Coordinate with clinical placement coordinator to explore daylight rotation schedules.
Connect with campus student-worker flexibility program.
meeting_talking_points: Inquire about work-life balance and sleep schedule management during clinical shifts.
Identify specific study intervals during off-duty days.

name: Andre Sousa
top_risk_factors: Unpaid library overdue fines and administrative hold
Delayed submission of Constitutional Law research paper

counseling_memo.summary: Upperclassman experiencing administrative roadblocks and thesis deadline compression.
action_items: Assist in clearing administrative holds to prevent exam registration blocks.
Set up writing lab consultation for thesis organization.
meeting_talking_points: Check progress on Constitutional Law research draft.
Ensure clear understanding of upcoming bar preparation requirements.

name: Sofia Chen
top_risk_factors: Language barrier during seminar oral presentations
First-generation college student adjustment

counseling_memo.summary: First-year international student displaying strong attendance and motivation with transitional adaptation in oral presentations.
action_items: Pair with international student mentor organization.
Connect with university English Academic Speaking workshop series.
meeting_talking_points: Discuss cultural integration, campus community connections, and conversational confidence.
Review oral presentation anxiety management techniques.

name: Diogo Ribeiro
top_risk_factors: High academic capability paired with severe lecture absenteeism
Working 30+ hours/week as freelance software developer

counseling_memo.summary: Talented student showing high exam aptitude but at risk of administrative failure due to breaching minimum lecture attendance guidelines.
action_items: Clarify institutional attendance compliance regulations to avoid automatic de-registration.
Formalize student-working-status dispensation with academic department if eligible.
Propose asynchronous project submission credits.
meeting_talking_points: Highlight the institutional risk of automatic failure regardless of high exam performance.
Explore course schedule adjustments or part-time student registration status.
